_note: The Keyguard Designer how-to course: every video in viewing order, from the support assets proposal (October 2026). The renderer reads titles and 'watch next' from here, so a title is changed in one place. 'id' is the script's id (scripts/video/scripts/<id>.mjs); an entry with no id has no script yet. 'path': true marks the groups watched in order. A video's number stays put once it's published, because its watch page's address comes from it, unless Ken decides otherwise (he did once, 30 Oct 2026, moving Saving Designs as Presets to 1.5: see CLAUDE.md, Renumbering); a new video goes at the end of its group.
